fit_reason: Although marked as a private seller, the listing text says it is for sale by Unique Classic Cars, and the photos show a dealer showroom with dealer plates and banners. This is dealer stock, not a private owner sale.
findings: Gold paint on the hood and front fenders looks flat with limited gloss
Light chalky dullness on the tailgate and bed sides
Small scuff marks on the lower tailgate area
Undercarriage pan and frame rails coated in dirt and grime
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1968 C10. The gold paint on the hood and tailgate looks a little flat in the photos, and a buff and polish could bring back a deeper shine. We do mobile pre-sale details and come to you. Would you like a quote?
